_run_note: CONCRETE TNK per-stem plans for the Desktop 'Drum STEMS' kit (262s full performance): kick in/beater, snare top/bottom, hi-hat, overheads (stereo), drum room (stereo). NO toms -> tom entries dropped; a hi-hat entry added (the committed tomorrow-never-knows-stem-process.plans.json template has none). Basenames match projects/tomorrow-never-knows/stems/phase-aligned/. DARK + gentle; the bus does the crush/color. declick forced OFF.
role: kick — deep, DAMPED thud (sweater-in-the-kick). Keep sub, kill ring, no click.
rationale: Damped thud: keep the 50-70 sub, -3 @350 to de-box/de-ring, NO beater-click boost (TNK kick is dull/damped). 550 flat. Measured centroid 2358 / tilt -5.12 (already a dark LF kick).

role: kick beater/click — minimal (TNK kick is damped, not clicky).
rationale: De-box + de-harsh, no click boost. Way down in the balance (TNK kick is the damped 'in' thud, not the beater). Measured centroid 3738 / tilt -1.71.

role: snare — thuddy, dark, present. No crack/air.
rationale: Keep the body, tame the bright edge with a gentle 4.5-7k dynamic de-harsh (TNK snare is dark/thuddy). NO air, NO transient snap, NO de-box (keep weight). 550 flat. Measured centroid 5339 / tilt -0.46 -> brightish, the de-harsh earns its keep here.
Just a hint of wires under the top: HPF 150, dynamic de-harsh on the buzz, NO air. Far down in the balance.

role: hi-hat — dark, pulled back; TNK is not cymbal/hat-forward. Tame the spit, no air.
rationale: Dark hat (NEW entry, not in the template): HPF 250 cleans bleed/rumble, -2 @450 de-box, firm 5-9k de-harsh kills the spit and keeps it dark, NO air. Folded well back in the balance (the OH carry the cymbals). Measured centroid 4870 / tilt +0.82 -> bright, so the de-harsh matters.

role: overheads (stereo) — DARK, cymbals back (TNK is not cymbal-forward).
rationale: HPF 120 + -2 @200 de-mud; a firmer 3-7k de-harsh keeps the cymbals dark/back. NO air. Pulled down in the balance. Measured centroid ~4000 / tilt ~-0.6. Renamed from the template 'overhead' to this kit's 'overheads.wav'.

role: room (stereo) — feeds the PUMP; keep low weight, dark.
rationale: Keep the room's low weight (HPF only 60) for the Fairchild to swell into the pump; dark, no air. Unlike Bonham, the room is NOT the loudest layer here — it's the pump fuel. Measured centroid 3895 / tilt -0.58.
